name: Snapchat (Snap Inc.)
tagline: Camera-first messaging app for close friends, with AR and Specs
facts: Large DAU market (~200M+ est.), low ARPU

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: Snap is a camera company; we contribute to human progress by empowering people to express themselves.

strategy.label: Vision
strategy.text: Computing overlaid on the world through AR glasses (Specs), built on Snapchat's camera and Lens ecosystem.

strategy.label: Core strategy
strategy.text: Own close-friend communication, grow content (Spotlight, Stories), and diversify revenue via subscriptions.

strategy.label: Moat
strategy.text: Opens to camera, ephemeral close-friend culture, Gen Z habit, Lens Studio AR developer ecosystem.

strategy.label: Key bet
strategy.text: Specs consumer AR glasses at $2,195 shipping fall 2026; plus AI Lenses and Snapchat+ tiers.

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: Should Snap spend on $2,195 AR glasses while ad ARPU still trails Meta by 10x?

customers.pain: Want private, low-pressure sharing with close friends
customers.why: Disappearing Snaps, streaks, Bitmoji, no public likes on chats

customers.who: Power users, streak and Memories savers
customers.pain: Want exclusive features and Memories storage
customers.why: Early features, streak restores, 250GB-5TB storage, Platinum ad-free

customers.pain: Need payouts and reach with young audience
customers.why: Unified creator monetisation program, Spotlight distribution

customers.pain: Need to reach Gen Z who skip Facebook
customers.why: Sponsored Snaps in chat, AR Lens ads, improved performance ad stack

customers.pain: Need distribution and tools for AR
customers.why: Lens Studio, Snap OS, 300M+ daily AR users

portfolio.key_metrics: ARPU, sub count and churn, ad CPM, Specs units
portfolio.guardrails: Ad load in chat, DAU growth, user sentiment

Device sales at $2,195; future app ecosystem

bullets.label: Revenue mix
bullets.text: Q2'26: ads $1.28B (+9%), other revenue $316M (+85%), mostly subscriptions.

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: 493M DAU vs ~25M Snapchat+ subs (~5%); NA ARPU far above Rest of World.

bullets.label: Unit economics
bullets.text: Q2'26 adj. EBITDA $250M, net loss $164M; Apr 2026 16% layoffs save ~$500M/yr.

bullets.label: Growth levers
bullets.text: Subscriptions, Sponsored Snaps, SMB performance ads, India monetisation, Specs.

friction: Confusing UI; hard for new or older users
Streak pressure and anxiety among teens
Paid Memories storage angered long-time users
Ads appearing inside private Chat inbox
Weak search and content discovery vs TikTok

competitors.label: AR glasses

competitors.text: Meta copying features, teen-safety laws, Specs cash burn, low ARPU
